entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:a2ui-catalog-designer
entries.intent: Design A2UI component catalogs and surface message streams, and validate them against the v1.0 schemas

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:agui-stream-engineer
entries.intent: Implement and audit AG-UI event streams — ordering, SSE encoding, state snapshots and deltas, reasoning and activity events, and human-in-the-loop interrupts

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:bridge-engineer
entries.intent: Implement and repair the host communication layer — lifecycle ordering, message hygiene, capability guards, and the protocol-agnostic adapter

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:csp-security-auditor
entries.intent: Derive the minimal CSP for an agent UI and audit it for untrusted-payload rendering, unsafe URLs, model-context injection, and leaked secrets

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:host-compat-auditor
entries.intent: Check every host API an agent UI depends on against each target host's support matrix and report the design consequence of each gap

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:mcp-app-builder
entries.intent: Implement a complete MCP App end to end — server registration, View, build config, and the local test loop

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:tool-schema-architect
entries.intent: Design the tool surface behind an agent UI so the model reliably invokes it — naming, descriptions, schemas, decoupling, visibility, and result channels

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:ui-accessibility-reviewer
entries.intent: Review an agent widget for WCAG AA conformance, keyboard operability, screen-reader semantics, and motion and text-scaling resilience

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:ui-perf-optimizer
entries.intent: Reduce bundle size, perceived latency, remounts, and render churn in an agent UI

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:ui-port-migrator
entries.intent: Migrate an agent UI between protocols by introducing the adapter layer, applying the field and API mappings, and surfacing every capability with no equivalent

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:ui-protocol-strategist
entries.intent: Choose the right agent-UI protocol stack for a requirement and defend the choice with rejected alternatives and the constraints that would change it

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:ui-state-architect
entries.intent: Place every value in an agent UI in the right ownership tier and make state survive remount without lying to the model

entries.name: mcp-apps-studio:widget-designer
entries.intent: Design the visual and interaction layer of an agent widget — display mode, layout, states, theming, and the host design rules
